verdict.rationale: Gitea lists "Audit Logs" and mentions "audit logging" as a generic security feature. Nothing in the evidence describes auditing AI agent sessions or actions, or attributing agent actions to the user who triggered them, including actions taken through the official MCP server. Generic audit logging is an adjacent feature, not the story's capability, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As a devops-lead, I can audit AI agent sessions and actions attributed to the user who triggered them
